qs.q:
Holiday Experiences — Which person…

A=Alf (coast hotel complex, ruined excursions, bored, cloudy, no tan, friend's recommendation)
B=Bela (first time alone in foreign city, printed maps, cooler than expected, gained confidence)
C=Cameron (avoided beach, explored city, loved market, scared of heights on minaret, kept to budget)
D=Dawn (group tour, felt left out, too many sights, bus after bus, overspent on shopping, overate)
E=Eddie (scared of flying, drove, slept in car, avoided local food, still fell ill, lost weight briefly)
F=Faye (familiar from Google images, tour below standard, accommodation/food disappointing, overpriced)

0. visited historical remains? [A=Alf: 'excursions to ancient monuments']
1. had visited the place before?
2. lost some weight?
3. would recommend the place?
4. didn't like the local food?
5. was disappointed by the weather?
6. was scared?
7. gained confidence?
8. felt they didn't get their money's worth?
9. felt lonely?
10. fell ill?
11. got bored?
12. spent more than they intended?
items: 8 — felt they didn't get their money's worth?

qs.q:
Bradley Wiele – champion cyclist

"He secretly borrowed his brother's bike... after a few crashes, he was on his way and could ride alongside his brother."

Bradley learned how to cycle…
A with his dad.
B with his brother.
C with friends.
D on his own.

Bradley Wiele

"On two wheels, Bradley felt he could go anywhere he wanted. He was no longer restricted to the street where he lived."

As a kid, Bradley loved cycling because…
A it gave him a sense of freedom.
B he could explore his neighbourhood.
C it was the most practical way to get around.
D he was thrilled at the speed he could go.
opts: it gave him a sense of freedom.
it was the most practical way to get around.
he was thrilled at the speed he could go.

qs.q:
Bradley Wiele

"'I knew he'd be good as soon as I saw him cycling round the track. He had the perfect build for a long-distance cyclist.'"

The Cycling Club head coach noticed Bradley because of his…
A body.
B enthusiasm.
C capacity for work.
D dedication.

Bradley Wiele

"'I was being paid for what I love doing.' He had opted to learn from Broad, one of the best coaches in the country, and improve his technique."

Bradley joined the professional cycling team…
A to earn money.
B to have more time for cycling.
C to have top quality coaching.
D to become famous.
opts: to have more time for cycling.

qs.q:
Bradley Wiele

"A spectator just appeared out of nowhere by the roadside and I overreacted and veered away from him and the rider behind me crashed into me. I've only got myself to blame."

Bradley says his accident in the 2011 Tour de France was…
A caused by a spectator.
B caused by another cyclist.
C his fault.
D destiny.

Bradley Wiele

"When I found myself lying on the road unable to move my arm, I got really angry and I was determined to come back next year and win the tour."

How did he react to being forced out of the 2011 Tour?
A He felt depressed.
B He saw it as a challenge.
C He felt a failure.
D He ignored it.
opts: He saw it as a challenge.
